actionResult.summary: 125 closes E1-RA-009 and E1-RA-010. E1-RA-008 remains open for historical legacy reset recovery, and E1-RA-011 is a new actualChangeSet/final verification publication mismatch blocker.

reviewFindings.title: Contract Reset recovery 仍用 post-reset current generation 重建 historical pending Run
reviewFindings.problem: 新 E1 spec 已明确 recoverContractResetPendingRun 必须基于 target pending Run 的 persisted entry lineage；122 production implementation 仍在 isContractResetOnlyPendingDrift 中调用 deriveSemanticInputs(current snapshot, context.action, descriptorsFromContext(context))。deriveSemanticInputs→collectContractRefs 又调用 computeResetAwareLineage(snapshot,...).artifact，因此 Reset 正确排除旧 proposal/apply generation 后，旧 pending Apply/revise-apply recovery 仍会要求 current generation producer，重现 `apply has no immutable propose producer generation` deadlock。
reviewFindings.contractRef: specs/flowkit-formal-fact-reader-and-persistence Requirement: Contract Reset recovery 必须保持 narrow admission；docs/flowkit-self-hosting-bootstrap-and-migration.md persisted-entry invariant
reviewFindings.invariant: historical pending Run 的 entry truth 来自其 persisted context/inputRef/producer-review lineage；Contract Reset 只改变 currentness，不能迫使 recovery 用新 generation 重新解释旧 Run。
evidence: src/services/b1-run-execution-service.ts:1360-1367 isContractResetOnlyPendingDrift 仍调用 deriveSemanticInputs(current snapshot, context.action, descriptorsFromContext(context))。
src/services/b1-run-execution-service.ts:1811-1814 collectContractRefs 仍通过 computeResetAwareLineage(current snapshot) 查 current stage producer，缺失时抛 `has no immutable ... producer generation`。
现有 reset recovery tests 只覆盖 pending explore；没有 approved proposal→pending apply/revise-apply→Contract Reset→old generation non-current 的 regression。
reviewFindings.impact: historical Apply/revise-apply 仍可能成为 orphan pending Run，阻断 fresh proposal generation，违反本次 E1 restart 后已冻结的 recovery contract。
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: 为 reset recovery 增加严格 historical reconstruction：以 target context.inputRef、consumed review result、reviewed producer ResultRefs及其 persisted contract/Owner refs重建原始 entry semantic view；只将 current applicable Contract Reset作为允许的唯一差异。缺失、歧义、hash mismatch或 mixed drift 均 fail closed，不得 fallback 到 current-generation producer lookup。
acceptance: synthetic approved proposal/review→pending apply→Contract Reset 后，旧 proposal generation 已 non-current 仍可由 official recovery取消为 superseded-by-owner-contract-reset
同样覆盖 pending revise-apply historical lineage
recovery 不要求 post-reset current propose producer
missing/ambiguous historical refs、multiple pending 与 mixed semantic drift 全部 fail closed

reviewFindings.title: 125 actualChangeSet 收录了 Core-owned verification.md 的 pre-publication bytes，record 不再描述最终 candidate
reviewFindings.problem: 125 在 Core 写入本 Run的 canonical verification.md 之前就从 Git base→post-action snapshot计算 actualChangeSet；deriveActualChangeSetFromCanonicalBase 只排除 .flowkit 路径，没有排除当前 Change 的 Core-owned verification.md。随后 publishVerificationSelection 重写 verification.md。因此 immutable selection record 中 verification.md 的 contentFingerprintAfter 绑定的是旧 publication，而最终 candidate 已是新 publication。
reviewFindings.contractRef: openspec/changes/change-verification-selection-and-change-set/design.md §6 entry snapshot 与 actualChangeSet；tasks.md 4.2/4.3；specs/flowkit-change-verification-selection/spec.md Requirement: Core 必须派生 canonical actualChangeSet
reviewFindings.invariant: reserved Core-owned verification publication 不进入 Author candidate sets；对 actualChangeSet 中保留的每个 file，contentFingerprintAfter 必须描述最终 candidate bytes，而不是 publication 前的临时状态。
evidence: src/services/b1-run-execution-service.ts:1388 先 deriveActualChangeSetFromCanonicalBase(..., postAction)，之后才在 publishVerificationSelection 中发布新的 canonical verification.md。

125 verification-selection.json 对 verification.md 记录 contentFingerprintAfter=324b87da22b2eac35ed7264ecab704892ffc21c1ef6d1a75f6e6c14d8cd28f09；最终 payload verification.md SHA-256=3ff76afe7e925caffe3bcabadfbac07149a45463a7d1126ab8a2981edf6ca1c0。独立重算 selection 中所有 non-delete entries，只有该 path fingerprint mismatch。
reviewFindings.impact: immutable actualChangeSet 与最终 cumulative candidate 不一致，并可能让 verification selection 把 Core 自己的 publication path 当作业务/OpenSpec candidate 输入；record 无法作为 final candidate 的可复验 change-set authority。
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: 按 approved reserved-path contract 修正 observation/selection：当前 Run 的 Core-owned verification publication 不得作为 candidate mutation 参与 observedActionMutations/actualChangeSet/verificationScope；对仍保留在 actualChangeSet 的每个 file，最终 immutable record fingerprint 必须与 terminal candidate bytes一致。不得通过在 record 中保留 pre-publication verification.md hash 规避。
acceptance: v5 Apply/revise-apply publication 后，actualChangeSet 不包含当前 Run 的 Core-owned canonical verification.md publication
对 immutable selection actualChangeSet 的所有 non-delete files 重算 terminal candidate SHA-256，全部与 contentFingerprintAfter 一致
verificationScope 不因 Core 自己写 verification.md 而扩大
增加 regression 覆盖 entry 时已有旧 verification.md、Core publication 后 bytes变化的场景
